comments.author: @MrCuriousEN
comments.text: Austria’s Alpine landscapes are beautiful partly because they are not completely untouched wilderness. 🇦🇹🌿 Generations of farmers have maintained pastures, moved livestock seasonally and shaped valleys that visitors now think of as naturally picturesque. Traditions like the Almabtrieb show how agriculture, landscape and cultural identity became inseparable over centuries.

replies.author: @eonatlas
replies.text: It’s truly fascinating how the deep connection between the farmers and the land has shaped such a stunning landscape! ❤
